name: Will I be able to live in my home during a custom renovation?

mainEntity.name: Will I be able to live in my home during a custom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can live in your home during a custom renovation depends on the scope and invasiveness of the project. For minor renovations like a single bathroom or kitchen update, staying in your home might be feasible, though certain areas will be off-limits. For extensive whole-house remodels, especially those involving major structural work, utility shut-offs, or significant dust and noise, relocating temporarily is often recommended for safety and comfort. We will discuss this during planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: It depends on the renovation's scope; minor projects may allow you to stay, but extensive work often requires temporary relocation for safety.
